notes.title: Trifox - 1.0.3.2 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have prepared another hotfix for you all to enjoy.

If you've been playing the game and enjoyed your experience so far, do consider leaving a Steam review as this really helps us out a great amount.

As always feel free to join our Discord (http://discord.trifox-game.com/) and let us know what you think of the game and/or the changes made within this patch.

All the best,
-The Trifox Dev Team

Full hotfix patchnotes below:

[h1]Level Changes[/h1]
[h2]4-1 Showdown[/h2]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in an infinite position reset loop if you fell into the abyss at the exact time the boss transitioned to its final blow stage.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could 1 shot the boss using certain attacks after dying during the final blow stage and replaying the final section of the fight.
[*] Turrets will now correctly target the boss weapons during the final stage of the fight.
[*] Ensured that turrets can apply the final blow to the boss.
[/list]

notes.title: Trifox - 1.0.3.1 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We decided to create a quick hotfix that fixes a minor camera issue during the final moments of the final bossfight. 
This issue was introduced with the previous patch and has now been resolved.

Full hotfix patchnotes below:

[h1]HUD and UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Replaced the XboxOne X,A,B and Y 3D icons with the different variants that closer match the 2D variants. This change should improve readability of the icons under different lighting conditions.
[*] Updated the default fallback controller X,A,B and Y 3D icons to use the more readable version matching the XBox One Controller glyph changes.
[/list]
[h1]Level Changes[/h1]
[h2]1-1 Shore Island[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 2 additional gold coins to guide players a little bit better towards the exit of the head puzzle chest.
[/list]
[h2]4-1 Showdown[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved one of the camera transitions after defeating the final boss.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera didn’t reset correctly after dying before applying the final blow to the boss.
[/list]

notes.title: RELEASE DATE AND NEW TRAILER!
notes.notes:
[b]Exciting news everyone – Trifox has a release date! It's going to launch on Steam (and other PC storefronts) on the 14th October! If you haven't already, be sure to add the game to your wishlist and you'll receive a reminder on launch day as soon as it's available.[/b]

In addition to the PC version, Trifox is also coming to consoles. It arrives on Nintendo Switch 13th October, and Xbox One and Xbox Series on 14th October. PS4 and PS5 versions won't be far behind, although we're still waiting for a confirmed date.

notes.title: Trifox Release Window - You asked, we answer!
notes.notes:
[h1]Finally, a release window![/h1]

After years upon years of hard work, by a small Belgian team of only three developers, finally we can start answering the most frequently asked question we had to face: When will the game release?

Well, we're feeling pretty good about September 😉

[previewyoutube=ayQbU5JdxtI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Does that mean the release date is set in stone?[/b] 

Not exactly. 

As you may have heard, Trifox is releasing on PC & Consoles and ideally, we want to release on all platforms at the same time. The porting process has been our biggest focus in recent months, making sure that all players across all platforms get the best possible experience. 

As we get closer to september, we'll be able to pinpoint an actual release date and when we do manage to lock that in, you'll be the first to hear it!

Thanks for sticking with us all these years, and know that we're just as excited as you are that players will finally get their hands on the finished game. Better get that controller warmed up!
